A_body_only_identified_type.problem: numeric(Type) reads complete StructType elements, but general functionText prints an identified struct name without its definition. New header-only renderer/type finder deliberately excludes body-only types. Both subject entry keys and incoming caller projections can therefore omit such definitions. f4 turns off only afterStage eligibility fast reuse for those types; original fresh eligibility can still accept both integer-only types and an old generic stage key can still match.
A_body_only_identified_type.conditions: Use independent LLVM contexts with same module ID/target/options/naming/block state. Preserve the explicit ExtractValueInst: IRBuilder constant-folding it during fixture construction would remove the body-only type and make the counterexample vacuous. Textual parser or ExtractValueInst::Create is suitable.
A_body_only_identified_type.reason: Both modules are valid: selected field0 has i32 in both. Original numeric() accepts both integer element lists; eligibleFunction can be true on both. Official Function::print contains only%T in the body, and no header/global/named metadata refers to%T, so header-mode world can be equal. Ordered local uses and hidden BB/VST fields can also be identical.
A_body_only_identified_type.not_proven: The simple extractvalue may optimize to the same zero and no object-byte difference has been executed. Do not call this demonstrated wrongcode. The issue is that the advertised exact input/eligibility binding omits an actual type read, without a reviewed default-pass semantic quotient proof.
A_body_only_identified_type.required_fix: Prefer deterministic complete body-reachable identified-type definition projection shared by subject input/output, incoming caller and MIR. Include recursive types/names/packedness/opaque state and types reached via operands/attributes where consumed. If the complete closure cannot be represented, explicitly reject that optional product schema at the shared function projector/admission; original Verify/optimization still runs. Fixing numeric() alone does not cover arbitrary incoming callers.
A_body_only_identified_type.exit_condition: Actual valid all-integer A/B counterexample must either produce different common complete function/world keys or both reject optional products, with complete current native/ordinary pipeline intact. Existing pointer-field admissible-vs-ineligible test is additional but insufficient: it only tests afterStage fast predicate, not two admissible entries.

B_orphan_caller.problem: Original eligibleFunction iterates F.users(), casts CallBase then invokes C->getFunction without checking insertion into a BasicBlock/function. New incomingCallersHaveCurrentOwners checks C->getParent but still invokes getFunction before validating that its BB has a parent Function.
B_orphan_caller.source_authority: Fixed LLVM Instruction.h217-224 explicitly says calling getFunction on an instruction not currently inserted into a function is undefined behavior.
B_orphan_caller.counterexample_design: Keep the subject F valid and create a detached CallInst using F, or attach that call to a detached BasicBlock. It still appears in F.users(). Guard code must reject before any API requiring a current function. Do not execute the old unsafe call as a regression oracle.
B_orphan_caller.required_fix: Unify a cheap safe owner gate before every original or new eligibility/world projection user walk: check CallBase, calledOperand==subject, BasicBlock* nonnull, BasicBlock::getParent Function* nonnull and parent Module==current. Obtain parent Function via checked BB rather than getFunction before its preconditions hold.
B_orphan_caller.limit: No valid source program crash has been demonstrated; native builders normally run a module verifier first. This is a real optional-hook API read precondition omission, especially when reasoning about post-pass intermediate owners, not a claim that the default compiler has already crashed on a valid project.

Fresh current owner/name/use/DbgRecord checks precede equality; ConstantExpr/external users reject. New world empty caller checks prevent ambiguous empty accepted projections. Unsupported named-type read still runs original predicate, but that is insufficient for the older generic key as described above.
